exposure: Skin-to-skin contact in the operating room after cesarean birth
outcome: Rates of in-hospital exclusive breastfeeding for neonates born via cesarean
cohort: Mothers and neonates undergoing cesarean birth at a single medical center with a cesarean rate of 30%.
finding: Implementation of skin-to-skin care in the operating room after cesarean birth was associated with an increase in exclusive breastfeeding rates at discharge from 33% to 69% over 18 months.
